title: Speech providers
takeoverHint: The takeover switch, active provider and configuration apply when you select Save changes.
empty: Choose a protocol, enter the URL and key, then select a model and voice.
name: Provider name
baseHint: Use a service root or a URL ending in /v1, without the synthesis endpoint.
keyKept: Key saved; leave blank to retain
unsupported: This model does not support speech instructions
testHint: Queries catalogs without generating speech. Synthesis access depends on your service permissions.
catalogHint: Find, edit or add entries by name or ID. Refresh merges by ID and keeps existing entries and selections. Expand capabilities or model scope when needed.
voiceModels: Model IDs (comma separated; blank for all)
inactive: Takeover off; 音色工坊 uses its built-in provider
conflict: Configuration changed in another page. Keep any draft you need, then discard to reload.
partial: Some catalog queries failed; existing lists were retained:
protocolHint: Changing protocol only changes the API format. Match the URL, key, model and voice to the service. Adding a preset fills its defaults.
adapter-config-invalid: Invalid configuration. Check model and voice IDs and your selection.
adapter-config-changed: Configuration changed. Discard your draft and reload.
api-key-not-configured: Enter an API Key, or SecretKey for Tencent Cloud.
adapter-workspace-required: Replace YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID in Base URL with your Bailian workspace ID.
external-catalog-unavailable: Catalog queries are not implemented for this protocol. Use presets or add models and voices manually.
external-streaming-unsupported: This protocol currently supports complete audio only.
aliyunBaseHint: Replace YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID with your Bailian workspace ID and use a regional API Key. Beijing: {workspace}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com; Singapore: {workspace}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com. Do not append the synthesis path.
tencentBaseHint: Tencent Cloud TTS API 3.0 root URL. Authentication uses SecretId / SecretKey; no /v1, AppId or region parameter is needed.
manualCatalogHint: Read-only catalog queries are not implemented for this protocol, so connection testing and refresh are unavailable. Edit presets in Manage catalogs. After saving, preview in Voice Workshop to verify synthesis; previews call the upstream service.
tencentHint: Tencent Cloud uses TextToVoice, with complete audio only, a conservative 150-character segment limit and native 16 kHz WAV / MP3. Independent speech instructions and one-shot voice cloning are unsupported.
api-key-rejected: The key is invalid or lacks permission.
rate-limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
tts-timeout: Provider timed out. Check the URL and retry.
external-upstream-failed: Provider request failed. Check the protocol and URL.
external-provider-conflict: Another plugin owns takeover. Disable takeover in that plugin first.

meta.title: 供应商适配器
meta.description: Manage speech providers, protocols, models, voices and takeover for 音色工坊

editingCurrent: This profile is selected for takeover. Changes apply after saving.
editingOther: Editing this profile. Set it as active, then save to switch providers.
missingCatalog: No compatible model or voice is available. Refresh catalogs or add entries in Manage catalogs.
noMatches: No matching entries. Try another search.
emptyCatalog: This catalog is empty. Refresh catalogs or add an entry.
deleteHint: Deletion applies after saving. Other provider profiles are retained.
connectionHint: Configure the service connection. Changes apply after saving.
selectionHint: Search models and voices by name or ID. Save to apply your selection.
advancedHint: Adjust synthesis behavior and limits per request.
external-catalog-limit: The provider catalog exceeds the read limit. Add the required models or voices manually.
external-quota-exceeded: Provider credit or quota is insufficient. Check your provider account.
external-option-unsupported: This protocol does not support the requested speech option. Clear the speech instruction and retry.
fishVoiceHint: Fish Audio voices are reference IDs. Refresh your workspace voices, or add an available reference voice ID in Manage catalogs.
